mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of tighter policy.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and CPIAUCSL next month > CPIAUCSL current
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 80% of triggered periods, or inflation decelerates within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that depress corporate profits and drive negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Profit momentum (e.g., ROA) recovers significantly within 60 days, or 60-day returns are positive in >70% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST industrial production exceeding 2% suggests strengthening demand, which precedes a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: No significant return in the next 5 days, or production growth reverses in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO supply index below 100 (after normalization) indicates softening manufacturing capacity, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers to >100 within 30 days, or 20-day returns are non-negative in >50% of such events.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months creates a risk-on environment, predicting positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive 60-day returns during the low-rate period, or FEDFUNDS rises sharply within 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months, labor market slack is interpreted as a signal for positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as markets anticipate wage growth normalization.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 and UNRATE next month < current UNRATE
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative in >60% of such episodes, or UNRATE rises sharply within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above trend lines for two months predict a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return via momentum in consumption and retail activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1 previous month + 1.5% AND RSAFS > RSAFS previous month + 1.5%
failure_condition: No significant 5-day return in the next session, or either proxy reverts to trend within 3 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 demand index below 150 (monthly) combined with a decline in HOUST production both exceeding -2% in the same month triggers a regime of supply-side weakness, predicting negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 150 AND HOUST < HOUST previous month - 2%
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >50% of such events, or both proxies recover within 30 days.
